cr_data.provenance:
Collection of the artist; gift to PMA, 1949 [1] 
 
1. According to the accessioning remarks O'Keeffe provided  
 
this painting in exchange for "White Petunias with  
Salvia" (1942‑12‑1), which she wanted returned to her due to flaking paint. Credit line transferred over from  
 
"White Petunias with Salvia" as Gift of George Howe  
 
(1886‑1955), but does not refer to previous ownership. 
 
(Source: Philadelphia Museum of Art, 2025)
remarks_1999: Double entries Downtown Gallery Archive. Whitney Archive indicates, "Infor. from Miss Bry of An American Place, July 1949. The Philadelphia Museum of Art exchanged their 'White Petunia with Salvia' [see Appendix II, no. 91] with Miss O'Keeffe for this picture." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1937. Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1937 and 1941. Dated 1937 on basis of inclusion in 1937–38 exhibition. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
